title: How Mickey One came about
summary: Arthur Penn heard Focus through his secretary.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: How did Mickey One come about?
Apparently Arthur Penn had heard Focus and liked it?
Stan knew Penn's secretary and the secretary made damn sure that Penn heard it, and I guess he kind of sold it.
As you said, I guess you were really pleased with the way that came out?
Yes. Most of the stuff I do I can't listen to, but I can listen to that.
What sort of set do you listen to it on; that could make a difference?
The only time I ever heard Mickey One was at the Institute

of Jazz Studies. I played it on their outfit, and there are some things on there-- it's like when you listen to something you know is a movie score, I think everybody picks out individual cues that they really like and there are things that really were impressive.
What I try to do is string them together in such a way that it made one big piece. I tried to do that.
It does that too. It takes a lot of listening to, but it does it.
There's much more continuity in that than there is in most movie scores that I've heard.
That just happens to be one of my favorites.
